# Launch catalog, role manifests, capability seeds, skiller resolve

Source: [JSON](../../../phases/P4/phase.json). This view is for people; agents use JSON through the Task API.

## Design

detailed

## Goal

Одна точка данных запуска роль × provider (launch catalog), пять role manifests, capability seeds для трёх bindings и `skiller resolve --role` с офлайн-проверкой closure; `start --scout` работает как раньше.

## Context

DECISIONS §5.2 (catalog), §6 (S1, S3 offline); D5 (manifests в orch), D6 (catalog в command-routing.json). Значения capability — knowledge/engine-port §binding-matrix, факты Q12–Q15.

## Scope

```json
{
  "include": [
    "packages/task/configs/command-routing.json orchestration.launch, command_catalog.py, scout.py",
    "packages/orch/roles/*.json, bindings/capabilities/*.json",
    "packages/skiller/lib/skiller/resolve.py, cli.py, bin/skiller"
  ],
  "exclude": [
    "запуск процессов",
    "per-run доставка skills (Plan 2)",
    "перенос catalog в orch (Plan 2)"
  ]
}
```

## Pitfalls

- Scout должен получить побайтно прежний argv (текстовый вывод, filter_answer)
- `--bare` запрещён (I12)
- Модели только через mappings (I8)

## Deliverables

- orchestration.launch
- 5 role manifests
- 7 capability seeds
- skiller resolve --role
